acceptanceCriteria: `corvint cem report` gains a machine output format with one record per hunk: path, line range at the bound revision, hunk digest, obligations, evidence digests with reasons, status, and the exact NOT_PRODUCED reason where applicable; the record set digest equals the digest the human report binds.
The projection is produced from the same CEM without re-reading the worktree and is read-only (invariant 4); a fixture in interop or experiments round-trips it against the human report.
docs/CHANGE-EVIDENCE-MAP.md or the cem-pilot-kit spec records the format with requirement IDs and one worked example from the dogfood loop on this repository.
The self-dogfood receipt for the delivering change is inspected through the projection and recorded in docs/BUILD-LOG.md.
body: Filed 2026-09-23 from the owner's review of JetBrains Air (jetbrains.com/air, JetBrains blog 2026-09-22): the owner accepted the idea for 1.0. Air is a cloud/IDE orchestration platform; only its contracts transfer. Invariant 7 (AGENTS.md) still holds: no hosted service, UI, daemon or network dependency on the local path. Air's review loop opens diffs in the session and lets the reviewer leave line comments the agent actions. Corvint's reviewer report (`corvint cem report`, DOGFOOD.md:68, TCQ-V0-054/058) is a human-readable document. A machine projection keyed by file and line range at the bound revision, carrying obligations, evidence digests, basis and every NOT_PRODUCED reason, lets an IDE, a PR review tool or an Air-style session render the evidence inline. This is the concrete drill-down shape for V1-0023, which it depends on.
title: cem report: emit a hunk-anchored review projection so any review surface shows why each hunk is covered and what is NOT_PRODUCED
